construction_pattern: Choose the set definition that matches the adopted natural-number convention; explicitly state whether zero is included.
target_skill: Recognise the defining boundary of N
variation_dimensions: Compare candidate definitions that differ only at zero; convention must be stated in stem or approved metadata.
distractor_strategy: Distractors swap zero inclusion or confuse N with W/Z.
independent_verification_route: Definition and membership truth-table check
notes: Natural-number convention remains provisional; do not silently assume it.

construction_pattern: Select the finite example or statement that is exactly equivalent to the adopted definition of N.
variation_dimensions: Vary notation, set-builder form and inclusion of zero while keeping the convention explicit.
distractor_strategy: Distractors introduce zero, a negative integer or a non-integer.
independent_verification_route: Enumerate candidate elements and compare against stated definition

construction_pattern: Identify the defining property that distinguishes W from N under the adopted convention.
target_skill: Recognise zero as a whole number
variation_dimensions: Use zero as the decisive boundary; avoid relying on ambiguous N convention unless specified.
distractor_strategy: Distractors exclude zero or admit negative integers.
independent_verification_route: Set-membership check against W={0,1,2,...}

construction_pattern: Choose the correct roster or set-builder representation of whole numbers.
variation_dimensions: Vary notation and truncated rosters; ensure ellipsis direction is unambiguous.
distractor_strategy: Distractors omit zero, include negatives or stop the infinite set incorrectly.
independent_verification_route: Check first elements, lower bound and continuation

construction_pattern: Identify the representation containing all negative integers, zero and positive integers, with no non-integers.
variation_dimensions: Vary roster notation, number-line description and set-builder notation.
distractor_strategy: Distractors omit zero, omit negatives or include fractions.
independent_verification_route: Check sign coverage and exclusion of non-integral values

construction_pattern: Select which listed values satisfy the integer definition, especially negative values, zero and non-integral values.
variation_dimensions: Use terminating decimals, fractions and signed integers only where each value is unambiguous.
distractor_strategy: Distractors treat every rational number or every decimal as an integer.
independent_verification_route: Exact-value conversion and membership check

construction_pattern: Choose the value that belongs to N from a mixed list of zero, negative and positive candidates.
variation_dimensions: Vary candidate order and magnitude; make the adopted zero convention explicit when relevant.
distractor_strategy: Distractors use zero or negative integers as boundary traps.
independent_verification_route: Direct set-membership evaluation

construction_pattern: Evaluate a simple integer expression and determine whether its result is a natural number.
variation_dimensions: Vary operation and sign of result; avoid arithmetic complexity overshadowing classification.
distractor_strategy: Distractors reflect sign errors and incorrect zero convention.
independent_verification_route: Independent arithmetic followed by N-membership check

construction_pattern: Select a whole number from candidates containing zero, positive integers, negative integers and non-integers.
variation_dimensions: Use zero and negative values as discriminators.
distractor_strategy: Distractors exclude zero or include negative values.
independent_verification_route: Direct membership check against W

construction_pattern: Evaluate a simple expression and select the result that belongs to W.
variation_dimensions: Vary sums, products and differences to produce positive, zero or negative outcomes.
distractor_strategy: Distractors use sign and arithmetic slips.
independent_verification_route: Independent arithmetic and W-membership check

construction_pattern: Select the integer among positive, negative, zero and non-integral candidates.
variation_dimensions: Use exact fractions or decimals whose non-integral value is certain.
distractor_strategy: Distractors assume all rational/decimal forms are integers.
independent_verification_route: Exact-value membership check

construction_pattern: Evaluate an expression and determine whether its result is an integer.
variation_dimensions: Use integer arithmetic and exact division cases; state any restrictions.
distractor_strategy: Distractors reflect division truncation or sign errors.
independent_verification_route: Exact arithmetic followed by integer-membership check

construction_pattern: Identify a negative integer that is not a natural number.
variation_dimensions: Vary negative magnitude and ordering; state convention if zero is a candidate.
distractor_strategy: Distractors include positive integers and possibly zero depending on convention.
independent_verification_route: Check sign and adopted N convention

construction_pattern: Identify a value outside N using zero or a non-integral candidate under the stated convention.
variation_dimensions: Use exactly one correct non-member; explicitly define N if zero is included in candidate set.
distractor_strategy: Distractors confuse zero convention and integer membership.
independent_verification_route: Set-membership truth check

construction_pattern: Select a negative integer, which is excluded from W.
variation_dimensions: Vary negative values while retaining clear non-membership.
distractor_strategy: Distractors include zero and positive integers.
independent_verification_route: Check W lower bound of zero

construction_pattern: Select a non-integral value that cannot belong to W.
variation_dimensions: Use exact fractions or terminating decimals not equal to integers.
distractor_strategy: Distractors include integer-valued decimal notation such as 3.0 only if notation semantics are explicitly addressed.
independent_verification_route: Convert to exact value before membership check

construction_pattern: Identify a rational number that is not an integer.
variation_dimensions: Use reduced fractions with non-unit denominator and non-integral value.
distractor_strategy: Distractors include fractions equivalent to integers.
independent_verification_route: Reduce fraction and test integrality

construction_pattern: Identify a decimal value that is not equal to an integer.
target_skill: Classify decimal values by exact integrality
variation_dimensions: Use terminating decimals with a nonzero fractional part; avoid recurring-decimal ambiguity unless defined.
distractor_strategy: Distractors use integer-valued decimal forms or sign mistakes.
independent_verification_route: Convert decimal to exact rational/integer comparison

construction_pattern: For one given value, determine membership in N, W and Z separately.
variation_dimensions: Vary value across negative, zero, positive and non-integral cases; state N convention.
distractor_strategy: Distractors confuse nested-set membership.
independent_verification_route: Evaluate each set membership independently

construction_pattern: Choose the smallest set among N, W and Z that contains a given integer.
target_skill: Use set nesting to identify the least applicable set
variation_dimensions: Use positive, zero and negative integer cases; zero depends on adopted N convention.
distractor_strategy: Distractors choose a larger containing set or wrong boundary set.
independent_verification_route: Verify N subset W subset Z and test membership

construction_pattern: Classify each value in a list against N, W and Z; select the correct completed matrix.
target_skill: Apply membership rules consistently across values
variation_dimensions: Use a balanced list spanning negative, zero, positive and non-integral values.
distractor_strategy: Distractors contain one-row or one-column membership errors.
independent_verification_route: Exhaustive value-by-set truth table

construction_pattern: Given a finite list, determine counts belonging to specified number sets or intersections/differences.
target_skill: Aggregate membership decisions without double counting
variation_dimensions: Vary list size and ask for one count; explicitly define N convention.
distractor_strategy: Distractors reflect overlap/double-counting and boundary errors.
independent_verification_route: Construct membership table then count

construction_pattern: For a specified integer, choose the smallest among N, W and Z that contains it.
variation_dimensions: Use positive, zero and negative values with explicit convention for zero.
distractor_strategy: Distractors select a valid but non-minimal superset.
independent_verification_route: Check all memberships and select minimal set

construction_pattern: Evaluate an expression first, then identify the smallest applicable set among N, W and Z.
variation_dimensions: Control arithmetic difficulty; include results at boundary values.
distractor_strategy: Distractors arise from arithmetic error or wrong minimal set.
independent_verification_route: Exact evaluation followed by set-membership ordering

construction_pattern: Determine whether zero belongs to N, W and Z under an explicitly stated convention.
variation_dimensions: The stem must state the natural-number convention; W and Z membership remain explicit.
distractor_strategy: Distractors interchange N and W conventions or exclude zero from Z.
independent_verification_route: Check stated convention and definitions of W/Z
notes: Do not generate until the adopted natural-number convention is fixed in the approved curriculum policy.

construction_pattern: Evaluate a set of statements about zero's membership in N, W and Z.
variation_dimensions: Use only statements whose truth follows from the explicitly stated convention.
distractor_strategy: Distractors confuse convention-dependent and convention-independent claims.
independent_verification_route: Truth-table each statement against the declared definitions

construction_pattern: Determine membership of a positive integer in N, W and Z.
target_skill: Recognise positive integers as members of all three sets
variation_dimensions: Use a positive integer and ask membership in each nested set.
distractor_strategy: Distractors omit membership in a superset or confuse subset direction.
independent_verification_route: Apply N subset W subset Z

construction_pattern: Choose the statement correctly describing a positive integer's membership and set containment.
target_skill: Connect a concrete value with inclusion relations
variation_dimensions: Vary the positive integer and statement wording while retaining the same mathematical property.
distractor_strategy: Distractors reverse inclusion or claim membership in only one set.
independent_verification_route: Check definitions and inclusion chain

construction_pattern: Determine which of N, W and Z contains a specified negative integer.
target_skill: Recognise negative integers as members of Z but not N/W
variation_dimensions: Use negative integers; avoid introducing non-integral values.
distractor_strategy: Distractors include negative values in W or N.
independent_verification_route: Check sign against lower bounds of N/W and integer definition

construction_pattern: Evaluate an expression known to produce a negative integer and identify its membership among N, W and Z.
target_skill: Combine signed arithmetic and set membership
variation_dimensions: Vary expression structure but keep arithmetic exact and manageable.
distractor_strategy: Distractors result from sign error or treating Z as positive-only.
independent_verification_route: Independent signed arithmetic and membership check

construction_pattern: Do not instantiate a question pattern until the corrupted QPC wording is recovered from an authoritative source/version.
target_skill: Preserve unresolved source data rather than infer meaning
variation_dimensions: No variations until source text is repaired and audited.
distractor_strategy: N/A
independent_verification_route: Compare QPC against source commit/history and decision register
notes: Original QPC label contains the literal fragment '(?1'; likely encoding/corruption, but intended meaning is unknown.

construction_pattern: Create a review record identifying candidate interpretations only after the original source is recovered; do not select one by guess.
variation_dimensions: No candidate question stems are permitted until wording is confirmed.
distractor_strategy: N/A
independent_verification_route: Source diff and human decision audit
notes: Do not silently normalize the label to ±1 or any other interpretation.

construction_pattern: Evaluate a sum, difference or product of integers and classify the result in N, W and Z.
target_skill: Determine closure/membership from an operation result
variation_dimensions: Vary operation and operands to yield positive, zero or negative integer results.
distractor_strategy: Distractors use arithmetic/sign errors or assume all results are natural/whole.
independent_verification_route: Independent arithmetic and set membership check
notes: Keep division out unless a separate QPC explicitly authorizes it.

construction_pattern: Construct an expression whose result is exactly zero or a negative integer, then test set membership.
target_skill: Handle operation results at set boundaries
variation_dimensions: Use cancellation or subtraction with transparent arithmetic.
distractor_strategy: Distractors misclassify zero or negative results.
independent_verification_route: Exact simplification followed by membership truth table
notes: Zero membership in N remains convention-dependent.

construction_pattern: Determine which statements about membership and inclusion among N, W and Z are correct.
target_skill: Reason from definitions and inclusion relations
variation_dimensions: Mix membership and subset statements; declare N convention where needed.
distractor_strategy: Distractors reverse subset direction or overstate equality.
independent_verification_route: Evaluate each statement independently from definitions

construction_pattern: Select a value that disproves a universal statement about number-set membership.
variation_dimensions: Use boundary values such as zero, negative integers or non-integral rationals as appropriate.
distractor_strategy: Distractors are values that fail to contradict the claim.
independent_verification_route: Verify candidate is a valid counterexample to the exact quantified claim

construction_pattern: Determine the truth values of several classification statements and select the matching vector.
variation_dimensions: Vary statement combinations and boundary cases; avoid ambiguous wording.
distractor_strategy: Distractors contain one flipped truth value or swapped set membership.
independent_verification_route: Truth table with explicit definitions

construction_pattern: Find the number of true statements among a specified list of membership claims.
variation_dimensions: Use four to six independent statements with mixed truth values.
distractor_strategy: Distractors reflect one missed boundary case or double counting.
independent_verification_route: Evaluate and record each proposition before counting

construction_pattern: Given a worked classification table or student's claims, identify the first incorrect membership assignment.
variation_dimensions: Include exactly one incorrect row/claim; make all other entries correct.
distractor_strategy: Distractors point to correct rows or confuse notation with membership.
independent_verification_route: Recompute each membership independently

construction_pattern: Choose the minimal correction that repairs an incorrect statement about N, W or Z.
target_skill: Repair conceptual errors without changing valid facts
variation_dimensions: Vary whether error concerns zero, negative values or subset direction.
distractor_strategy: Distractors introduce a second error or over-correct valid membership.
independent_verification_route: Formal definition and counterexample validation
